results.title: SIMONE
results.overview: While taking his routine beachside jog, Haitian immigrant Marcel Lambert gets a call from his mother about the death of her lifelong friend, Simone. Marcel is taken aback by the news. Unbeknownst to his mother, Marcel has kept a secret from her about Simone, which he confides in his therapist.

results.title: Stacey & Sly
results.overview: Two cousins must decide if they should return to their home on Earth

results.title: Budget Paradise
results.overview: Seeking a spot to post up and make their art, Chester finds themself tossed from every corner of a city hell-bent on displacing anyone unwilling to fall in line with its profit-driven agenda.

results.title: Rosa <3
results.overview: A sensual hommage to Germany's most productive queer filmmaker, Rosa von Praunheim.

results.title: My Homeland
results.overview: The Czech Philharmonic, DEKKADANCERS, the Forman Brothers Theatre and Jatka78 perform Bedřich Smetana's masterpiece, "Má Vlast." Six symphonic poems resonate through the Czech landscape and history as a colorful map of memories, feelings and moments. The unyielding “Šárka”, the combative “Tábor”, the mythical “Vyšehrad” and “Blaník”, the magical “Vltava” and the romantic “Luhy a háje” come to life on stage thanks to classical music, contemporary dance and the poetics of the new circus.

results.title: Fellow Travelers
results.overview: Young programmer Kirill dreams of presenting his startup to influential businessman Oleg Potapov. But instead of a business meeting, he finds himself caught up in a dangerous and comical chase. Potapov and Katya are running away from their pursuers, and suddenly he mistakes Kirill for his old friend Siziy. Under a hail of bullets, Potapov literally drags Kirill into the car himself, and they drive away from their pursuers together...

results.title: Clock - Socialist Burgers Inc.
results.overview: Clock looks, smells and tastes just like any other fast food chain. Its owner? The Swedish state.

results.title: Strobe
results.overview: In a near dystopian future, a stone-faced Hitman sneaks into the eerie, filthy appartement of a Government Agent.

results.title: The Flats
results.overview: In his tower-block apartment in New Lodge, Joe reenacts memories from his childhood amidst the “Troubles”. In this Catholic area of Belfast, the number of deaths was tragically significant. Joe is joined by neighbours Jolene, Sean, Angie, and others, all willingly participating in this process of revisiting the collective memories that shaped their lives and the district they live in.

results.title: Shinran: Jinsei no Mokuteki
results.overview: A historical film depicting the youth of Saint Shinran, founder of Jōdo Shinshū Buddhism, during the turbulent times between the late Heian and early Kamakura periods, about 850 years ago.

results.title: The Return of the Lame Hero
results.overview: Hiding among the gangsters is like walking on thin ice—can the fiery youth hold onto their original aspirations and prove themselves? As the wheels of time roll on, the gangsters' rampant activities and "spectacles" have faded away. Today's peace and security are our best "proof".

results.title: We're All Gonna Die
results.overview: In the near future, the "Spike," a 10,000 mile tall indestructible floating alien tentacle materializes in Earth's upper atmosphere, causing everybody to freak out. By now, though, everyone's gotten used to it. But after the Spike teleports a struggling beekeeper's beehives and a grieving wanderer's prized car halfway across the country, these two strangers must join together and take a dangerous roadtrip across a changed (but recognizable) America to get their stuff back.

results.title: April Tune
results.overview: Early Spring. A sonata, a train, a letter. Between his work as a flute teacher and the rituals of mourning the early death of his wife, Samuel faces a dilemma after a visit from his brother.

results.title: Fire Within
results.overview: Unhoused in San Francisco, Dawn and Tony find solace with Terry and Harry, who facilitate support groups at Glide Church. There, they are challenged to overcome their circumstances and stand up for their community. The film weaves together their intimate stories of resilience and their fight to reclaim their place in society. A powerful story of resilience, community, and hope, set in the heart of San Francisco’s LGBTQ+ advocacy movement.

results.title: Grabbin a Cold One
results.overview: The plan was simple: Larry invited Kyle over to make him the first friend he'd ever had. So what happens when his guest accidentally chokes to death? Larry sees this as an opportunity to make Kyle his permanent best friend.

results.title: No Problem
results.overview: Max and Jura are teenage friends growing up on the streets of Zagreb. In an effort to become independent from the family home, they also seek financial independence by reselling designer clothes and shoes. They come to an arranged meeting with two older guys, Tony and Black, to buy tennis shoes from them. But the differences between the friends are increasingly coming to the fore - one is cautious, the other is impulsive. The situation gets complicated when Jura does not bring his share of the money. Money, trust and the boundaries of friendship are at stake.

results.title: Stiina
results.overview: 28-year-old Stiina is a single mother raising her 9-year-old daughter Emma by herself. While Stiina is working, Emma is often left home alone. What Stiina doesn't know is that Emma has a friend that keeps her company and comforts her when bad things happen. What neither of them know, is that Emma's friend is actually more connected to them than they realise.
